title: German-Style Arabian Chicken Tagine
description: A twist on the classic North African tagine, this German-inspired dish features tender chicken and aromatic spices, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and black pepper.
Heat the Arabian spice blend in a pan over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and sauté until softened.
Add the chicken thighs to the pan and cook until browned on all sides.
Transfer the chicken and onion mixture to the casserole dish or tagine pot.
Add the diced tomatoes, chicken broth, and salt to the casserole dish or tagine pot.
Cover the casserole dish or tagine pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, then reduce the heat to 275°F (135°C) and continue cooking for another 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the chicken and sauce over couscous or rice.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
